drivingQuestion: Is the mishna's rule that individual offerings render substitutes universal?
outcomeNote: Both objections answered by limiting the mishna to the primary offering

segments.he: וַהֲרֵי וָלָד דְּקָרְבַּן יָחִיד הוּא, וְאֵין עוֹשֶׂה תְּמוּרָה! הָא מַנִּי? רַבִּי יְהוּדָה הִיא, דְּאָמַר: הַוָּלָד עוֹשֶׂה תְּמוּרָה.
segments.en: The Gemara objects: «But» what about the «offspring» of a sanctified animal, «which is» brought and sacrificed on the altar as «an offering of an individual» of the same type as its mother, «and» yet it «does not render» a non-sacred animal exchanged for it «a substitute?» The Gemara explains: In accordance with «whose» opinion «is this» mishna? «It is» in accordance with the opinion of «Rabbi Yehuda, who said» that «the offspring» of a sanctified animal «renders» a non-sacred animal exchanged for it «a substitute.»

segments.he: וַהֲרֵי תְּמוּרָה עַצְמָהּ, דְּקׇרְבַּן יָחִיד הִיא, וְאֵין תְּמוּרָה עוֹשָׂה תְּמוּרָה! כִּי קָתָנֵי — בְּעִיקַּר זִיבְחָא קָתָנֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara objects: «But» what about «a substitute itself, which is» brought and sacrificed on the altar as «an offering of an individual, and» yet «a substitute does not render» a non-sacred animal exchanged for it «a substitute?» The Gemara answers: «When» the mishna «teaches» that an offering of an individual renders a non-sacred animal exchanged for it a substitute, it «is teaching» this only «with regard to the primary offering,» not a substitute of an offering.

segments.he: הַשְׁתָּא דְּאָתֵית לְהָכִי, אֲפִילּוּ תֵּימָא רַבָּנַן, בְּעִיקַּר זִיבְחָא קָתָנֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara comments: «Now that you have arrived at this» answer, «you» can «even say» that the mishna is in accordance with the opinion of «the Rabbis,» who disagree with Rabbi Yehuda and maintain that the offspring of an offering does not render a non-sacred animal exchanged for it a substitute. The reason is that one can explain that the mishna «is teaching» its halakha only «with regard to the primary offering,» not the offspring of an offering.
